descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
OKAPI is a product design & development company that helps startups and established enterprises turn their ideas into polished products.
 We are looking for a Frontend Engineer who loves building interfaces that are both beautiful and data-rich: from reusable JavaScript components and design systems to interactive graph networks and data visualizations with D3.
 What You Bring 
3+ years of professional frontend development with modern JavaScript and TypeScript
Strong experience with React (or a similar component-based framework)
Proven experience building reusable component libraries or design systems (Storybook, design tokens)
Hands-on experience with D3.js and data visualization (charts, dashboards, interactive views)
Experience with graph / network visualization with D3
Solid HTML, CSS and SVG skills
Good eye for UI detail and experience working from Figma designs
WCAG 2.1/2.2 Level AA: familiarity with accessibility guidelines and how to implement them
Experience with testing, Git and CI/CD
Experience using AI coding tools (e.g. Copilot, Cursor, Codex, Claude Code) in your workflow
Good spoken and written English
 What You'll Do 
Build and maintain reusable JavaScript/React components as part of our design systems
Turn complex data into clear, interactive visualizations and graph networks
Optimize rendering performance for large datasets
Work closely with designers to ship pixel-perfect, accessible interfaces
Integrate frontends with REST/GraphQL APIs
Write clean, tested, well-documented code and take part in code reviews and Agile ceremonies
 Who You Are 
Analytical and visual: you enjoy making complex data easy to understand
A systems thinker who builds reusable, scalable solutions
A clear communicator who works well with designers, developers and product managers
Organized, adaptable and comfortable with ambiguous requirements
Curious and quick to learn new tools and technologies
 We are offering 
A friendly international environment where you can follow your passions and develop your skills
A flexible schedule (no strict working hours)
Paid vacations
A variety of interesting & challenging projects
Performance bonuses
 Come join us and see how ideas come to life!
